subject.title: docs: add direct Kubernetes manifest apply path

question: Should OpenClaw make `scripts/k8s/manifest.yaml` plus a raw `kubectl apply` URL an official Kubernetes install path, or should this PR narrow to neutral Helm wording only?
rationale: The patch is not just wording cleanup: it adds a documented deployment workflow and a generated artifact that users may rely on across upgrades, which repo policy treats as setup and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Direct Manifest Support
options.body: Approve the generated single-file manifest as an official install path, then resolve current-main conflicts and rerun exact-head checks before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Wording Cleanup
options.body: Keep the Helm-neutral docs change but remove the new generated manifest path if maintainers do not want to support raw-main `kubectl apply`.

options.title: Pause Or Close Direction
options.body: Close or pause the PR if Kubernetes install docs should remain deploy.sh/Kustomize-only for now.

recommendation.title: Accept Direct Manifest Support
recommendation.body: Approve the generated single-file manifest as an official install path, then resolve current-main conflicts and rerun exact-head checks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom introduced the Kubernetes install guide and manifest baseline that this PR extends, and the contributor explicitly requested review from that area.
